estimators.ratio: P32.3: mean over rounds of reader_mops(scan) / reader_mops(next_after_scan), paired within each round, BCa 95% interval
estimators.columns: per-cell reader_mops_mean is the mean over rounds with a BCa 95% interval; reader_mops_median is auxiliary; P32.3 reads paired ratios over rounds
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples verbatim

scan_cells.schedule: each round runs both probe blocks, alternating which goes first; within a block the eight (read_op, W, R) treatments follow that round's row of a Williams design; one harness process per treatment; the throughput pass runs every round before the counters pass
scan_cells.soundness_gates: not evaluated by this driver: a cell read before every §32.2 gate passed on the measured head is void (§32.6)

p32_3.statistic: mean over rounds of reader_mops(scan) / reader_mops(next_after_scan), each ratio paired within one round of the throughput build, with a BCa 95% interval (METHODOLOGY.md §32.4 P32.3)
p32_3.decision: LB_AT_OR_ABOVE_FLOOR when CI lower bound >= floor across all gated cells (3.0x at W=0, 2.0x at W=1 R=4); LB_BELOW_FLOOR when any gated CI lower bound < floor. Two independent runs combined via --scan-cells-verdict
